request.style: English, orchestral, female solo voice with choir, harp, organ, cello, strings, reverent and solemn, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Levites stood in the court that day
Jeshua and Kadmiel led the way
Bani and Hashabneiah stood tall
Sherebiah and Hodiah heard the call
Shebaniah and Pethahiah joined in
To bless the Lord from past to present

[Chorus]
Blessed be your glorious name
Which is exalted above all fame
Above every blessing and praise
We lift our voices in the haze

[Verse]
They bound themselves with a curse and an oath
To walk in the Law of God
Given through Moses the servant true
To keep and carry out all that is due
With judgments and statutes of the Lord
Bound to the covenant, a solid word

[Chorus]
Blessed be your glorious name
Which is exalted above all fame
Above every blessing and praise
We lift our voices in the haze

[Bridge]
In Jerusalem the work continued
Levites served as it was intended
Uzzi son of Bani served there
Descendants of Asaph in the prayer
Singers in the house of God
Keeping the faith of the old road

[Chorus]
Blessed be your glorious name
Which is exalted above all fame
Above every blessing and praise
We lift our voices in the haze

[Outro]
Blessed be your glorious name
Exalted above every fame
